policy: Freeze before runs and runtime fixes. Changes require a new protocol ID. Never treat fixtures, blocked prerequisites, unexecuted cases or user stops as task successes.

tools: native browser_exec/terminal/files in scoped Docker executor
settings.authentication: Direct native ticket; adapter signed envelope; application real ClerkJS session JWT verified by production current_account against disposable PostgreSQL. No authentication override.
settings.credential_transport: Same fixed Luna-only loopback relay on every surface; renewable credential stays with existing product gateway
settings.fixture_prompt_correction: Replace sentence-ending @handle. with @handle for verification. before sending the disposable test request. No server/runtime/parser mutation.
settings.persistent_agent_roles: Explicit Researcher, Writer and Reviewer instructions configured through the public agent.configure contract before admission. Source file plan_role_groups.py is frozen with this cohort.
settings.role_answer_leakage: Role instructions do not contain the expected numerical answer; agents must calculate it from the original user facts.

scenarios.oracle: Persistent Researcher hands verified arithmetic to Writer and Reviewer; final scoped artifact is readable, authors and handoff lineage preserved. Writer must produce the canonical artifact; Reviewer must read that artifact through the authorized workspace tool and independently verify its arithmetic. Role/config differences are explicit, not attributed causally to the adapter.

metrics.task_success: successful / planned, plus successful / executed; never omit failures
metrics.integration_failure: integration-attributable failures / executed, unknown attribution kept separate
metrics.recoverable_tool_failure: tool errors recovered within successful task / executed
metrics.unknown_effects: unresolved effects / dispatched effects; missing denominator is unavailable
metrics.duplicate_effects: duplicate external effects / dispatched effects; missing instrumentation is unavailable
metrics.latency: monotonic admission, first progress and settlement p50/p95 nearest-rank; report n; no zero for absent samples
metrics.recovery: restart readiness and restoration duration p50/p95, with n
metrics.uncertainty: Wilson 95% interval for task success; n=3 is smoke evidence only
metrics.candidate: Record native/direct/product prompt and tool differences per attempt; do not pool previous batches, and do not attribute unequal settings to integration.
metrics.effect_metrics: Use supervisor journal operation IDs plus fixture POST/file ledgers; unknown receipts remain unknown and prevent replay.

release_thresholds.applicable_cases: All required live cells executed; no blocked cell is a pass.
release_thresholds.confidence: Release requires at least 100 representative tasks per supported configuration in NMA-039; three repeats do not establish the SLO.

replay: Read-only JSONL aggregation. Replay never imports workers or invokes tools. Re-running external actions requires a new explicit run and fresh fixture.
purpose: Six separately frozen role-bound group cells. Compare explicitly configured product role behavior with native SOUL-configured peers; preserve earlier generic-agent outcomes. No result is substituted into the 99-cell corpus.
